reward.failure_rule: first physical violation or safe-no-actuation command and every remaining internal sample
reward.invalid_rollout: reject complete update; retain attempt and remaining unopened population

warning_definition.target: first physical violation or safe-no-actuation in the next 30 commands
warning_definition.leave: 30 consecutive supported scores strictly below exit_threshold

provider_definition.early_trigger: explicit scheduled intervention; not a prediction
provider_definition.warning_trigger: first frozen natural withdrawal request, including unsupported observations
provider_definition.handoff: one irreversible episode-local latch; no reentry in this diagnostic
provider_definition.selected_handoff: unchanged selected actor, slew from actual preceding correction and issued history
provider_definition.baseline_handoff: unchanged v1 uncertain refusal; immediate zero residual
provider_definition.unsupported: original unsupported refusal to deterministic baseline, including after selected handoff
provider_definition.warning_after_handoff: retain shadow prediction; never return control to the challenge actor

pair_comparison.post_handoff: fresh causal trajectories; no equality requirement
pair_comparison.fresh_baseline_regression: all 1440 controller rows and 7200 trace rows match retained reach hold per group

production_entrypoints.stepping: mj_step1 then held inputs then mj_step2

coverage: actual public history and selected transfer
complete native state, contact and named-force streams
all complete sequence guards and ranking; independent original Python best-sequence forecast
every internal motor force and native/canonical geometry
valid refusal audited with explicit censored outcome
streamed readers retain only adjacent control rows and bounded summaries
not_covered: inverse dynamics or feasible wrench certificate
prefix: original challenge through command 59; actual resolved history continues at command 60
candidate: configured receding sequence selection with bound nominal-refusal history seed and actual public-resolved history
code_path_risks_covered: missing native steps or contact samples
bounded aggregate storage and contained worker lifetime
scheduled replanning and truthful allocation-free memory
baseline_transition: total target slew is recorded; residual slew does not bound baseline change
synthetic_clock_check: retained public observations; alternative actions did not generate observations

comparison_endpoints.primary: first physical violation under unchanged height, tilt and torso-contact rules
secondary: actual motor reconstruction and held-interval change
comparison_endpoints.interpretation: two exposed condition-specific development pairs; no robustness or superiority qualification

refusal_policy: retain final controller row and unchanged native state; stop before transfer and abort remaining worlds; audit available complete streams
component_handoff_scope: verified weak retained commands60..73 including fallback68..72 and restored nominal73; nominal60..61 on both cores
completion_semantics: owner ok means verified complete execution or valid retained refusal, never recovery success; full comparison requires all four complete worlds

selection_seed.recipe: immutable sampler base plus 10000 times command plus iteration; one exposed physical development seed

reference_reconstruction: whole host replay on other core; all retained sequence guards and objective ranking; independent Python best full sequence
prediction_error_scope: first selected five internal steps versus new native steps only; later sequence intervals remain forecasts; diagnostic without retrospective tolerance fitting

resource_basis.budget_exhaustion: retain original failure and available streams; no complete comparison or recovery claim
